title: two base proofs that patch the ticket store in the asker hand the same store to the CodeMother they launch
intention: The two cairn/tools/base proofs that patch ticket_file._TICKETS in the asker (test_the_rehearsal_lane_is_retired, test_the_crossing_compares_what_the_inspector_found) hand the same store to the CodeMother they launch, so every judge they ask reads the fixture tickets they wrote. The rehearsal and build_inspector proofs are child tickets (RULE 1).
why: Measured 2026-11-14 by akiendell_cc_0: 03daad62ef1b's unseen_patches over main plus the import_sieve fix flags these four files for patching ticket_file._TICKETS around transitions calls whose judges run in CodeMother's process (17d570c10390); 3e08102ef35a fixed the same shape in three other proofs. After the change the tooth reads 0 findings on each.
traces_to: Law 8 (a green over a store the judge never read is a hollow green a peer leans on); Law 3 (the store the judge reads is measured, not assumed).
how: In each of the two proofs, the launch of CodeMother names ticket_store= the same patched store (3e08's launch kwarg); the crossing-compares proof's ExitStack launch closes in its finally.

out: cairn/machines/rehearsal and cairn/machines/build_inspector (the two child tickets)
